answer: None of the articles tells customers to use a retired form. The only retired form mentioned is NW-POA-1, which was replaced by NW-POA-2 on February 1, 2026. 'When more than one person owns the car' does mention it, but only to say that an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was accepted until June 30, 2026, and that grace period has now ended. The help center doesn't say whether any other form (NW-EST-1, NW-LPA-1, NW-MIL-1, NW-PU-1) has been retired, so please confirm their status with a store or the forms owner.

facts.fact: Selling a family member's car for them (still says NW-POA-1)
Broken or replaced odometer (still says NW-ODO-1)
